Definition: Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Miphkad is the name of a gate in Jerusalem, the Muster Gate, and it appears once in the record of the wall's rebuilding. Malchiah the goldsmith's son repaired the stretch over against the gate Miphkad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gate's name fits the work: muster means gathering for inspection, and the whole wall was built by neighbours mustered side by side.
